scope: Eleven Page/Frame selector actions and captured-target input snapshots for locator/selector keyboard actions. Experimental native macOS arm64/Bun1.4.2 development acceptance; no release or performance claim.
changes: Shared action validation and dispatch preserve native targeting and one operation deadline; Page/Frame default to first match and explicit strict=true rejects duplicates. Locator stays strict.
Pointer, keyboard focus and both ordinary/traced mutation resolution preserve selector strictness through retries.
Traced press/type retain the original target across input capture and recheck its document/connection before focus; application focus changes still direct subsequent characters.
setChecked trace records identify the underlying check/uncheck method while keeping the public action title.
retainedDevelopmentAttempts: The first fixture attempt failed on the reference because hover was already active and need not emit another mouseover.
The second fixture attempt failed on the reference because selectOption intentionally emits an untrusted input event.
The third fixture passed113 browser checks but archive inspection exposed missing keyboard input-phase snapshots. That native gap was repaired before the137-check run and full core acceptance.
All earlier raw attempts and static review manifests remain private; no timing samples were selected or discarded.

limitations: Pointer steps, hover noWaitAfter and selectOption ElementHandle values remain outside this action slice.
